main_text.p: [illegible, ~8 letters] conductio, ita & cessantibus hæresibus cessaturam omnem hujus scientiæ necessitatem. Sed ne a proposito digredi videamur, ex his quædicta sunt quid sit El-mol' Calam, & quid Al Motacallemin constat, esse sc. AlCalam [?Arabic: معرفة طريق المجادلة] ut loquitur idem Al-Gazalius [Greek: ?] & el Motacallemin [Arabic: اهل الكلام?] fusiorem ejus descriptione ex Ebnolkossai petere possumus [Arabic: الكلام علم بحث عن ذات الله وصفاته واحوال الممكنات من المبدإ والمعاد على قانون الاسلام?] AlCalam est scientia quâ disquiritur de Essentia Dei & Attributis ejus & conditionibus rerum possibilium circa creationem & restitutionem, juxta Canones Islamismi; vel juxta alios [Arabic: العلم بالقواعد الشرعية الاعتقادية المكتسبة عن الادلة اليقينية?] Scientia fundamentorum legalium quæ ad articulos fidei pertinent, quæ per demonstrationes certas acquiruntur. Vel ex Authore Al Mawakef qui ipse hujus scientiæ Systema composuit, [Arabic: علم يقتدر معه على اثبات العقايد الدينية بايراد الحجج ودفع الشبه?] Scientia quâ idoneus redditur quis ad confirmandas confessiones [ seu articulos ] religionis, aliatü probationibus, & dubia solvenda. Quid erit ergo aliud quam Theologia Mohammedistarum Scholastica? atque ita quid Hebraorum [Hebrew: חכמת דברים & מדברים?] quibus Arabum [Arabic: علم الكلام & المتكلمين?] reddunt; & apud eorum interpretes Latinos per Sapientiam verborum, & Loquentes, intelligendum fit, constat.
Scientiæ juris] Ita [Arabic: علم الفقه?] reddimus, cùm tamen vulgò obtinuerit, ut [Arabic: الفقيه?] Sacerdos reddatur. Quid p.18 l.1. autem

page.notes: Greek word at the start of the first line and the Greek in the Gazalius line are not clearly legible at this scan resolution; the Arabic passages are transcribed from a low-resolution image and every doubtful word is marked [?]. The Hebrew second word and the Arabic in the Motacallemin and Arabum passages are also uncertain. The page ends mid-sentence ("Quid autem"), continuing on the next page.
